top_stories.title: Musk v. Altman Is a Battle for OpenAI's Soul [Metered]
top_stories.summary: Wired reports on the legal confrontation between Elon Musk and Sam Altman, framing it as a fundamental dispute over the direction and control of OpenAI. The case touches on OpenAI's transition from nonprofit to for-profit structure and Musk's claims about the organisation's founding mission. The outcome could have significant implications for AI governance and the future of one of the world's most influential AI companies.

top_stories.title: xAI rolls out Grok 4.3 beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers
top_stories.summary: xAI has released a beta version of Grok 4.3, made available to SuperGrok Heavy subscribers. The update represents a continued iteration of Musk's AI model offerings as xAI competes in the large language model space.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Expands Copilot and AI Agent Capabilities in Power Apps
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has announced expanded Copilot and AI agent capabilities within its Power Apps platform, broadening the reach of AI-assisted development tools for business users. The move reflects Microsoft's continued push to embed generative AI across its enterprise software stack.

top_stories.title: Dairy Queen is putting an AI chatbot in its drive-thrus
top_stories.summary: Dairy Queen is deploying an AI-powered chatbot in its drive-thru lanes, joining a growing number of quick-service restaurant chains experimenting with AI automation for customer ordering. The system is developed in partnership with Presto, a drive-thru AI technology provider.

top_stories.title: The Download: bad news for inner Neanderthals, and AI warfare's human illusion [Metered]
top_stories.summary: MIT Technology Review examines the growing debate around meaningful human oversight in AI-enabled warfare, questioning whether the 'human in the loop' concept provides real control or a false sense of accountability. The piece highlights concerns from researchers and ethicists about how autonomous systems are being deployed in defence contexts.

further_links.title: The 'AI is inevitable' trap
further_links.summary: The Verge's Vergecast podcast examines the 'AI is inevitable' narrative promoted by figures like Sam Altman and whether framing AI adoption as unavoidable forecloses important debates about its risks and direction.

further_links.title: The beginning of scarcity in AI
further_links.summary: Venture analyst Tom Tunguz argues that AI compute is entering a period of genuine scarcity in 2026, with demand for inference and training capacity outpacing supply in ways that could reshape the competitive landscape.

further_links.title: Forbes 2026 AI 50 List | Top Artificial Intelligence Companies
further_links.summary: Forbes has published its 2026 AI 50 list, highlighting the top private artificial intelligence companies across industries.

further_links.title: AI Drafting My Stories? Over My Dead Body [Metered]
further_links.summary: A Wired writer pushes back on the idea of AI being used to draft journalism, arguing that the craft and intent behind writing cannot and should not be delegated to generative AI tools.

further_links.title: George Orwell Predicted the Rise of "AI Slop" in Nineteen Eighty-Four
further_links.summary: Open Culture draws a parallel between Orwell's fictional 'versificator' machine in Nineteen Eighty-Four and the modern phenomenon of low-quality AI-generated content flooding the internet.

further_links.title: CIOs Struggle to Deliver Business Value as AI and Complexity Expose Gaps in Their Applications Strategy
further_links.summary: A new report from Info-Tech Research Group finds that CIOs are facing mounting pressure to demonstrate tangible business value from AI investments, with complexity and fragmented application strategies cited as key obstacles.

further_links.title: How robots learn: A brief, contemporary history [Metered]
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review offers a concise overview of the key developments in robot learning, from early reinforcement learning to modern approaches using large models and simulation.

further_links.title: Recent advances push Big Tech closer to the Q-Day danger zone
further_links.summary: Ars Technica reports on diverging approaches among major technology companies to post-quantum cryptography readiness, as advances in quantum computing bring the threat of breaking current encryption closer to reality.

further_links.title: Microsoft Expands AI and Copilot Capabilities in Power Apps
further_links.summary: Burke research firm announces a partnership with an AI analytics company, reflecting growing adoption of AI-driven tools in the market research sector.
